dedupe_keys.name: aafc annual crop inventory crop type map of canada 2009 onwards

description: The Annual Crop Inventory is a yearly crop type map of Canada made by the Earth Observation Team of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada since 2009, first for the Prairie Provinces at 56 m and from 2011 for other provinces. The open.canada.ca entry for 2025 says a decision tree classification of Landsat-8, Landsat-9, Sentinel-2 and RADARSAT Constellation Mission imagery gives a 30 m map of all provinces and the Yukon, trained with provincial crop insurance data and field observations, with burned areas from Natural Resources Canada fire perimeters. Each year is published as pre-packaged GeoTIFF files, ESRI REST image services, a crop class CSV and ISO 19131 product specifications in English and French, downloadable and free under the Open Government Licence - Canada; the 2025 entry was created on 8 July 2026 (a University of Manitoba copy also has DOIs). Coverage is national. Caveats: resolution and sensors change between years, and accuracy varies by region and crop. For simulation it gives field-scale crop types to expose Canadian agriculture to drought, floods and fire, and to model grain and oilseed supply chains. Related catalogue records include the USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer and the JRC EUCROPMAP.
